messages:
tanya-partnerships: Idea for a boutique marketplace pilot: call it \"Greenroom Credit Ladder\". Offer small upfront grants that unlock larger discount slabs as customers hit usage milestones over 180 days. Aimed at GSIs and HW partners who bring PoCs -> want predictable conversion mechanics. Thoughts on renewal gating and how to prevent gaming? :mortar_board:

ken-sales: I like it. Sales note: sellers prefer predictable commission math. suggest a 2-wave commission model: normal commission on net new ARR, but credits count as 'pipeline assist' with a capped bonus once customer converts to committed SKU. prevents pushing credits for churn.

vikram-ops: Ops caution: staged credits + milestone checks require event-driven reconciliation. marketplace supports webhooks but we need to define a deterministic milestone signal (e.g., cumulative_metered >= milestone threshold). Otherwise customers could split accounts. Also need to limit cross-SKU stacking.

nora-legal: Legal flags: 1) credits are promotional and expire 180 days; 2) milestone verification window +/-14 days; 3) renewal auto-opt-in only if customer achieved >=70% of final committed tier in last 90 days; 4) require partner-signed addendum for co-sell SI/HW deals. I'll draft.

data-finance: Preliminary sim: assume 8% conversion baseline for grants -> committed, 20% if SI co-sell. Key metric: time-to-first-bill. If TTFB > 90d economics degrade. Suggest cap_per_account = 25k for pilot and strict clawback triggers if we detect fraud/stacking.

eng-marketplace: Implementation plan: add a new offer type `greenroom_ladder_v1` with metadata: \"tiers\": [\"tier1\",\"tier2\",\"tier3\"], \"milestones\": [\"50u\",\"200u\",\"1000u\"], and attach webhook endpoint for milestone events. ETA for listing + webhook wiring ~10 business days. We'll also need a small reconciliation lambda to calculate burned credit per account.

hw-partner-ops: For HW partners we want to map grants to device SKUs (on-prem usage). We can emit a synthetic meter that aggregates device activations to prevent SKU fragmentation. Need eng to agree on synthetic meter naming conventions.

tanya-partnerships: Good call on synthetic meters. Also want a guardrail: partners can't piggyback credits across accounts they own. Ops: any friction for allowing partner-specific addenda on private offers?

vikram-ops: Partner addenda supported but increases onboarding time. Suggest onboarding checklist: partner contract signed, meter mapping approved, dashboard access, support-rotation set. Estimate extra 5 days for partner adds.

ken-sales: Messaging: put a bold line in the listing \"Discounts unlock as usage grows, not retroactive\". Reps need easy talking points. I'll draft a 1-pager and sample scripts for SI kickoff calls.

nora-legal: Also include a one-liner in the listing: \"Renewal rights require verification of usage; Redwood reserves right to audit.\" Don't overpromise refunds.

eng-marketplace: Quick sample metadata JSON for the listing we can use in the PR:

```
{
  "offer_type": "greenroom_ladder_v1",
  "tiers": [
    {"name":"bronze","milestone":"50","discount":"10%"},
    {"name":"silver","milestone":"250","discount":"20%"},
    {"name":"gold","milestone":"1000","discount":"30%"}
  ],
  "credit_cap": "25000",
  "expiry_days": "180",
  "milestone_window_days": "14"
}
```

vikram-ops: That looks good. We'll want to store `milestone_verified_at` and `verification_proof_id` for audit. Also add clause to FAQ about account consolidation impacts.

data-finance: Please tag simulated cohorts with SI vs self-serve. I'll run sensitivity for conversion uplift assumptions and post numbers Wed. If we see >15% uplift with SI, scale pilot.

hw-partner-ops: We'll coordinate with one hardware partner (NebulaDevices) for pilot. They'll provide device activation feed to our webhook and a partner-signed addendum.

tanya-partnerships: Action list: 1) @eng-marketplace open draft listing PR + sample metadata (ETA Mon), 2) @nora-legal draft addendum + renewal/audit clause (ETA Tue), 3) @data-finance run cohort sims (ETA Wed), 4) @ken-sales draft seller 1-pager + commission holdback language (ETA Tue), 5) @vikram-ops prepare runbook & reconciliation lambda design (ETA Wed), 6) @hw-partner-ops onboard NebulaDevices for device feed (ETA Aug 10).

marketplace-bot: Draft listing stub created: https://marketplace.internal/redwood/drafts/greenroom-ladder-v1 (internal).

ken-sales: I'll loop in the top SI PMs for messaging feedback once the 1-pager is ready. :email:
